mentions.name: Tractorfan
mentions.description: An agricultural community site for tractor enthusiasts, relaunched from a Dutch community to reach a more international audience.
mentions.problem: The original Dutch community was limited to a Dutch audience and aimed to reach an international one.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I relaunched one of my Dutch agricultural communities to reach a more international audience. I’m starting to see great traction and it’s very rewarding:
https://www.tractorfan.us

mentions.name: TractorFan
mentions.description: A niche online community for fans and users of tractors, relaunched after 15 years. It is part of a broader network of niche sites covering the agricultural, heavy equipment and transportation sectors, hosts around 10M pages, and receives pretty decent traffic.
mentions.audience: Fans and users of tractors in the agricultural, heavy equipment and transportation sectors
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just relaunched my 15 year old niche online community for fans and users of tractors:

https://www.tractorfan.us

It’s part of a broader network of niches within the agricultural, heavy equipment and transportation sectors.

It has around 10M pages and pretty decent traffic.
